question.text: When will Anthropic be publicly traded?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the option corresponding to the first date (EST) on which shares of common stock of Anthropic, PBC begin trading on a public stock exchange (e.g., the Nasdaq Global Select Market).
question.fine_print: This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46443) which opened on 2026-11-02 16:00:00. This question will resolve based on the resolution criteria and fine print of the linked original question. However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. Additionally, if the original question's resolution could have been known before this question opened, then this question will be annulled.

## Anthropic IPO timing: research brief (as of 2026-11-09, about 13:00 UTC)

Anthropic has not started trading and no listing date has been set. Bloomberg reported (relayed second-hand) that the roadshow begins today with a lower valuation target. However, no price range has been filed with the SEC, and Reuters and WSJ reports say the deal could slip.

### 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the first day Anthropic, PBC common stock trades on an exchange. Its filings say Class A shares will list on Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT".
- 2026-11-09: The SEC's EDGAR filing list for Anthropic (CIK 2130357) shows a confidential draft filing on 2026-06-01, five draft amendments (the last on 10-09), the public S-1 on 10-26 and an amended S-1 on 11-02. There is no price-range amendment, no 8-A12B exchange registration, no effectiveness notice and no free-writing prospectus yet. [EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=2130357&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40)
- 2026-11-02: The amended S-1 still leaves the price, share count and amount raised blank. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/anthropic-could-postpone-1-5-155825407.html)

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. Before trading can start, Anthropic needs to file a price range, run the roadshow, get the SEC to declare the registration effective, and price the offering.
- 2026-10-26: The S-1 became public. SEC rules require 15 days between the public filing and the roadshow, so the roadshow could start no earlier than Nov 10 (Yahoo's count). On that count the earliest pricing is Nov 13 and the earliest first trade is Mon Nov 16. At SpaceX's pace, the first trade would be Nov 18. Yahoo calls Thanksgiving (Nov 26) the outer limit. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/when-is-the-anthropic-ipo-the-stock-could-start-trading-as-soon-as-nov-16-132727631.html)
- Note that the Nov 10 earliest roadshow start does not match the reported Nov 9 marketing start. I could not resolve this.

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-09: IPO Newsroom on X, relaying Bloomberg, said Anthropic "is starting to market its IPO today" at a lower valuation target. The target itself was not disclosed, and I could not read the Bloomberg article directly. [FourWeekMBA](https://fourweekmba.com/ai-anthropic-said-to-start-ipo-marketing-at-a-lower-target/)
- 2026-11-09: German outlets citing Reuters say the listing was originally planned for Nov 19 or 20 and "may be delayed". [finanznachrichten](https://www.finanznachrichten.de/nachrichten-2026-11/70073451-nasdaq-mega-ipo-anthropic-ipo-wackelt-so-kommen-anleger-aus-deutschland-an-die-aktie-049.htm)
- 2026-11-07: The Financial Times reported Anthropic will go ahead and aims to list before Thanksgiving, raising $80-100B at a $1.25-1.75T valuation. [Yonhap](https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20261109017200009), [GuruFocus](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9183991/anthropic-ant-advances-ipo-plans-with-adjusted-valuation-amid-market-volatility)
- 2026-11-07: In the WSJ, three investors said the valuation must come down, possibly to about $1T. Another investor raised postponing the IPO entirely. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/anthropic-could-postpone-1-5-155825407.html)
- 2026-11-06: Reuters exclusive, citing four sources: investors doubt the roadshow can go ahead next week in time for a November listing. Anthropic could postpone if AI stocks stay weak, and investors are waiting for October revenue data. [BNN Bloomberg](https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/artificial-intelligence/2026/11/06/ai-backlash-could-threaten-anthropic-ipo-timing-potential-investors-say-reuters-exclusive/), [Globe and Mail](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-anthropic-ipo-valuation-ai-investors/)
- 2026-11-06: The Information reported Anthropic will go ahead with the roadshow next week. The article is paywalled. [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/anthropic-proceed-ipo-roadshow-next-week)
- 2026-11-05: The Nasdaq lost about $2.5T in market value and the VIX volatility index rose from 16.6 to 28.2, after the midterms. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/anthropic-could-postpone-1-5-155825407.html)

### 4. Base rates
- SpaceX in 2026: S-1 public May 20, roadshow from June 4, priced June 11, first trade June 12. That is 8 days from roadshow launch to first trade and 23 days from public filing. [Capital.com](https://capital.com/en-int/market-updates/spacex-ipo-prices-12-06-2026), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/when-is-the-anthropic-ipo-the-stock-could-start-trading-as-soon-as-nov-16-132727631.html)
- Older large IPOs, from memory and not checked here: Alibaba (2014) and Facebook (2012) each took roughly 8 to 11 days from roadshow launch to first trade.
- Applied to a Nov 9 or 10 launch, that range points to a first trade around Nov 17-20. This is an analogy, not a forecast.
- Large IPOs do get postponed when markets turn volatile. I did not find a systematic rate.

### 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket "Anthropic IPO Date" (prices as of 2026-11-09 13:01 UTC; this market matches the question most closely):
  - Nov 13 or earlier: 1.3%
  - Nov 16: 3.9%
  - Nov 17: 6.3%
  - Nov 18: 11.7%
  - Nov 19: 13%
  - Nov 20: 21%
  - Adding up: before Nov 18 is about 11%, and Nov 18-20 is about 46%.
  - Prices for Nov 23 onward were not captured. FourWeekMBA cites an 80.5% chance of an IPO by Nov 30.
- Polymarket "In which month will Anthropic IPO?": November 77.7%, December 7.5%, January 2027 3%. "Anthropic IPO by Dec 31, 2026": 87%.
- Kalshi "officially announce an IPO": before Nov 16 9%, before Dec 1 77%. The definition of "announce" may not match first trading day.
- Manifold: no relevant date market found.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- An amended S-1 with a price range and share count. This would confirm the roadshow is live, and its timing points to the pricing date.
- Anthropic's October revenue data, which investors are waiting for.
- How AI and tech stocks move, and the VIX level, during the weeks of Nov 9 and Nov 16.
- The 8-A12B exchange filing, the SEC effectiveness notice, and the pricing announcement (usually the evening before the first trade).
- Thanksgiving: markets are closed Nov 26 and close early Nov 27, which narrows the late-November window.
- Any official postponement announcement.

I could not find any primary confirmation of a pricing or listing date.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** Forecasts close today, Nov 9, 2026. The outcome will be known by the first trade or by Dec 1, roughly 1 to 3 weeks from now.

(b) **Status quo:** Anthropic is not trading and no price range has been filed. If nothing changed, the outcome would be "Not before December". But the process is clearly moving, so the status quo is not static here.

(c) **Base rates:**
- Mega-IPOs (SpaceX 2026, Alibaba, Facebook) took about 8 to 11 days from roadshow launch to first trade.
- From a Nov 9 or 10 launch, that points to Nov 17-20, mostly Nov 19-20.
- Large IPOs launched into volatile markets get postponed a meaningful share of the time, perhaps 15-25%.
- The late-November window is thin. Nov 26 is a holiday and Nov 27 is a half day, so Nov 30 is the only realistic trading day in the "After Nov 25 & before Dec 1" option.

(d) **Strongest evidence:**
- Nov 9: Bloomberg, relayed second-hand, says marketing starts today at a lower valuation target. A lower target signals Anthropic is willing to price the deal rather than pull it.
- Nov 9: Reuters, via German outlets, says the listing was originally planned for Nov 19 or 20 but may be delayed.
- Nov 7: The Financial Times says Anthropic aims to list before Thanksgiving.
- Nov 6: The Information says the roadshow goes ahead next week.
- Nov 6: A Reuters exclusive says investors doubt a November listing is feasible.
- Nov 5: The VIX rose to 28 after the midterms.
- Nov 9 Polymarket prices: before Nov 18 about 11%, Nov 18-20 about 46%. The month market puts November at about 78%, which implies roughly 21% for Nov 23-30 and roughly 22% for December or later.

(e) **Unexpected scenario:** The roadshow launches, but weak demand at the reduced valuation, or a further sell-off in AI stocks, forces a pause after a week. The deal is then pushed to December or January. A second path: the SEC timing or a 15-day count dispute pushes pricing a few days later, landing the first trade on Nov 23-24.

**How I moved from the anchor:** The Polymarket prices are a strong anchor for the same event. I shifted Nov 18-20 slightly upward, from 46% to 50%, because the Bloomberg report confirms the marketing launch. I took that mainly from the Nov 23-25 bucket. I kept a substantial tail for postponement given the volatility and investor pushback.

(c) Base rates: mega-IPOs usually take 8 to 11 days from roadshow launch to first trade. SpaceX in 2026 took 8 days, and Facebook and Alibaba took roughly 8 to 11. A roadshow starting Nov 9 or 10 therefore implies a first trade around Nov 17 to 20. Large IPOs launched into volatile markets are sometimes delayed by a week or more, or postponed outright. I found no systematic rate, so I am assuming something like 15-30% under stress.

(d) Strongest evidence:
- Nov 9: Bloomberg, via a relay, says marketing starts today at a lower valuation target. A lower target is a signal that Anthropic is proceeding rather than pulling the deal.
- Nov 7: The FT says Anthropic is proceeding and aims to list before Thanksgiving.

(e) Unexpected scenarios: AI stocks keep falling during the roadshow and order books come in thin at even about $1T, so Anthropic postpones to January. Alternatively, demand is strong, books close early and the stock trades Nov 17. A further option is a one-week slip to Nov 23 or 24 to digest the October revenue data.

It may be partly priced in already, and it nudges probability toward a November listing in the Nov 17 to 20 window. The missing price-range filing and the volatile market keep a meaningful chance of delay. I moved about 1 to 2 points from Dec+ toward Nov 18-20.
